mechanism_narrative: Sustained quarterly growth in total demand (GDPC1) above 13,000 billions of chained 2017 dollars signals an expanding economic base, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in 3 out of 4 consecutive quarters with GDPC1 above 13,000.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% triggers a surge in labor market confidence, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when UNRATE crosses below 5.0, or the effect persists for less than 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate above 4.0% and a sustained decline in the CPIAUCSL below 2.5% signals aggressive monetary tightening, compressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative (p > 0.05) despite the monetary tightening signal, or the effect lasts less than 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion characterized by rising industrial production (INDPRO > 95) and falling unemployment (UNRATE < 4.0%), stronger supply-side growth and labor market stability drive positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in the regime condition, or the effect diminishes within 30 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above 94.8 (its 5-month average) indicates robust supply-side activity, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when INDPRO crosses above 94.8, or the effect is transient (<10 days).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent quarterly growth in total demand (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) above their 5-month averages signals a robust economic expansion, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) despite both demand proxies rising, or the effect lasts less than 20 days.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the federal funds rate below 2.0% indicates prolonged monetary easing, lowering discount rates and boosting equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) in 3 out of 4 quarters with FEDFUNDS below 2.0%, or the effect is transient (<15 days).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in total demand (GDPC1) above 13,331.6 (its 6-month average) signals a robust economic recovery, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (p > 0.05) when GDPC1 crosses above 13,331.6, or the effect is transient (<10 days).
